## Cls
Clears the current buffer with the color set by [ClsColor](BlitzBasic-Drawing#clscolor). Call it at the start of every frame when you redraw the whole picture.

```blitzbasic
;media still drawing/cls.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
ClsColor 40, 90, 160
Cls
Color 255, 255, 255
Text 160, 120, "Cls cleared this to blue", 1, 1
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Cls](media/drawing/cls.png)

## ClsColor
Sets the color that [Cls](BlitzBasic-Drawing#cls) clears with. It does not change the drawing color of [Color](BlitzBasic-Drawing#color). Values are clamped to 0 through 255.
@param red    Red part, 0 to 255.
@param green  Green part, 0 to 255.
@param blue   Blue part, 0 to 255.

## Color
Sets the color that `Plot`, `Line`, `Rect`, `Oval` and `Text` draw with.

```blitzbasic
;media still drawing/color.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 7
	Color i * 36, 255 - i * 36, 128
	Rect 10 + i * 38, 80, 30, 80, 1
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Color](media/drawing/color.png)
@param red    Red part, 0 to 255.
@param green  Green part, 0 to 255.
@param blue   Blue part, 0 to 255.

## ColorRed
@returns The red part, 0 to 255, of the current drawing color.

## ColorGreen
@returns The green part, 0 to 255, of the current drawing color.

## ColorBlue
@returns The blue part, 0 to 255, of the current drawing color.

## GetColor
Reads the pixel at a position of the current buffer and makes it the drawing color. Use [ColorRed](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorred), [ColorGreen](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorgreen) and [ColorBlue](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorblue) afterwards to see what it was.
@param x  Horizontal position of the pixel.
@param y  Vertical position of the pixel.

## Line
Draws a line between two points. Both end points are drawn, and the line is made of whole pixels like in the original.

```blitzbasic
;media still drawing/line.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 319 Step 16
	Color i * 255 / 319, 160, 255 - i * 255 / 319
	Line 160, 0, i, 239
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Line](media/drawing/line.png)
@param x1  Horizontal position of the start.
@param y1  Vertical position of the start.
@param x2  Horizontal position of the end.
@param y2  Vertical position of the end.

## Origin
Moves the point that counts as 0, 0 for everything you draw after it. Shapes, text and images move with it, the viewport does not.

```blitzbasic
;media still drawing/origin.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 255, 80, 80
Rect 0, 0, 40, 40, 1
Origin 160, 120
Color 80, 255, 80
Rect 0, 0, 40, 40, 1
Color 255, 255, 255
Line -100, 0, 100, 0
Line 0, -100, 0, 100
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Origin](media/drawing/origin.png)
@param x  Horizontal position of the new origin in the buffer.
@param y  Vertical position of the new origin in the buffer.

## Oval
Draws an ellipse inside the box given by position and size.

```blitzbasic
;media still drawing/oval.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 255, 200, 0
Oval 20, 20, 120, 120, 1
Color 0, 200, 255
Oval 170, 40, 130, 80, 0
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Oval](media/drawing/oval.png)
@param x      Horizontal position of the left side of the box.
@param y      Vertical position of the top of the box.
@param width  Width of the box.
@param height Height of the box.
@param solid  1 fills the ellipse, 0 draws only its outline. Defaults to 1.

## Plot
Draws a single pixel in the drawing color.
@param x  Horizontal position of the pixel.
@param y  Vertical position of the pixel.

## Rect
Draws a rectangle.

```blitzbasic
;media gif drawing/rect.gif 60 30
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
For frame = 0 To 59
	Cls
	Color 255, 255, 255
	Rect 20, 20, 280, 200, 0
	Color 255, 160, 0
	Rect 30 + frame * 3, 90, 40, 60, 1
	Flip
Next
```

![Rect](media/drawing/rect.gif)
@param x      Horizontal position of the left side.
@param y      Vertical position of the top.
@param width  Width in pixels.
@param height Height in pixels.
@param solid  1 fills the rectangle, 0 draws only the outline. Defaults to 1.

## ScanLine
@returns Always 0. The original returned the line the monitor was drawing, which a modern display cannot tell.
@gap Always returns 0. Use `VWait` or `Flip` to synchronise with the display instead.

## Viewport
Limits all drawing to a part of the buffer. Anything outside it is cut off, and [Cls](BlitzBasic-Drawing#cls) only clears the inside. The part that sticks out of the buffer is cut off as well. Call `Viewport 0, 0, GraphicsWidth(), GraphicsHeight()` to reset it.

```blitzbasic
;media still drawing/viewport.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 60, 60, 60
Rect 0, 0, 320, 240, 1
Viewport 60, 60, 200, 120
Color 255, 120, 0
Oval 0, 0, 320, 240, 1
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Viewport](media/drawing/viewport.png)
@param x      Horizontal position of the left side of the viewport.
@param y      Vertical position of the top of the viewport.
@param width  Width in pixels.
@param height Height in pixels.
